text:
53세 여성 환자, incompatible blood transfusion 후 acute hemolytic anemia로 입원함.

Vital signs:
- BP 90/60 mmHg
- HR 120 bpm
- RR 22
- BT 38.1°C
- SpO2 95% on 2L nasal cannula

Severe fatigue 호소함.

Furosemide 40 mg IV q12h 적용함.

Oxygen support: Nasal cannula 유지함.

Compatible blood transfusion 시행함.

I/O: Input 1000 mL, Output 1200 mL.

Clinical status: drowsy 확인됨.

Hematology team notify함.
